title: [Bug] DeepSeek-V3.2 with FP8 KV Cache, Assert Error
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I searched related issues but found no solution.
- [x] The bug persists in the latest version.
- [x] Issues without environment info and a minimal reproducible demo are hard to resolve and may receive no feedback.
- [x] If this is not a bug report but a general question, please start a discussion at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/discussions. Otherwise, it will be closed.
- [x] Please use English. Otherwise, it will be closed.

### Describe the bug

When I tried to deploy deepseek-v3.2 with fp8 kv cache, I met this assert error:
```
[2025-12-08 15:20:22] [/bin/sh@<0,0>]:   File "/sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/base_attn_backend.py", line 101, in forward
[2025-12-08 15:20:22] [/bin/sh@<0,0>]:     return self.forward_extend(
[2025-12-08 15:20:22] [/bin/sh@<0,0>]:            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
[2025-12-08 15:20:22] [/bin/sh@<0,0>]:   File "/sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/flashmla_backend.py", line 410, in forward_extend
[2025-12-08 15:20:22] [/bin/sh@<0,0>]:     forward_batch.token_to_kv_pool.set_kv_buffer(layer, cache_loc, k, v)
[2025-12-08 15:20:22] [/bin/sh@<0,0>]:   File "/sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/memory_pool.py", line 1505, in set_kv_buffer
[2025-12-08 15:20:22] [/bin/sh@<0,0>]:     assert not (self.use_nsa and self.nsa_kv_cache_store_fp8)
```
which is raised by `sglang/srt/mem_cache/memory_pool.py-->MLATokenToKVPool-->set_kv_buffer`.

I totally understand why this assert error happens, but I don’t understand why an assert error is added here. From the parameter descriptions elsewhere, the NSA architecture should support FP8 KV, yet it’s being disabled by an assert here.

```
    def set_kv_buffer(
        self,
        layer: RadixAttention,
        loc: torch.Tensor,
        cache_k: torch.Tensor,
        cache_v: torch.Tensor,
    ):
        layer_id = layer.layer_id
        assert not (self.use_nsa and self.nsa_kv_cache_store_fp8)
```

### Reproduction

```
    --model-path /models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2 \

    --dp-size 16 \

    --prefill-round-robin-balance \
    --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
    --moe-a2a-backend deepep \
    --attention-backend flashmla
```
